title: Car Rental Dynamic Book Prediction
summary: A machine learning system that predicts whether a car rental customer should book now or wait for a better price, using multiple models (XGBoost, Logistic Regression, Prophet, LSTM) trained on synthetic booking data. SDV's SingleTableMetadata, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, and TVAESynthesizer are run in notebooks and a custom synthesizer script to generate the multi-table training data, with sdmetrics QualityReport used to evaluate it.
evidence: notebooks/scripts/improved_sdv_synthesizer.py:16-269 imports and calls CTGANSynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer to generate training data
